sentences.text:
on 10 November,
2023  HIGH COURT OF CHHATTISGARH, BILASPUR  Order Sheet  In Re : I.A. No. 1/2023  CRA No. 869 of 2023   Dharmendra Nishad S/o Panchram @ Panchu Nishad Aged  About 20 Years R/o Village Nagabuda, Police Station  Gariyaband District Gariyaband Chhattisgarh  ---- Appell  Versus   State Of Chhattisgarh Through Police Station Gariyaband  District Gariyaband Chhattisgarh  ---- Responden 10-11-2023 Appellant has preferred this criminal appeal being aggrieved by the impugned judgment of conviction and order of sentence dated 28-2-2023 passed by learned Additional Sessions Judge,
Fast Track Special Court (POCSO and Rape cases), Gariyaband (CG) in POCSO Case No. 83/2020,
whereby the appellant has been convicted under Section 363, 366, 376 (2)() of IPC and Section 6 of the POCSO Act and sentenced as under :-
Section Jail sentence Fine sentence Default stipulation 363, IPC 3 years RI Rs. 300/-
15 days SI 366, IPC 5 years RI Rs. 500/- 25 days SI 376(2)( ), IPC 10 years RI Rs.
1,000/- 50 days SI 6, POCSO Act 20 years RI Rs. 2,000/- 100 days SI Heard Ms.
Ranjna Jaiswal, learned counsel for the appellant and Mr. Avinash Singh, learned Panel Lawyer appearing for the State/respondent on the instant application for suspension of sentence and grant of bail (I.A. No. 1/2023) preferred by appellant Dharmendra Nishad.
It has been argued by learned counsel for the appellant that as per prosecution case,
though the victim is stated to be a minor girl aged about 17 years and 7 months on the date of incident as per Dakhil Kharij register and Halafnama register in which date of birth of victim is mentioned as 8-1-2022, which has been proved by P.W. 5 Smt.
Hansa Gajbhiya, Head Master of the School, but the same is not authentic proof regarding age, however, relying on the said Dakhil Kharij register and Halafnama register, the trial Court has found the victim to be a minor.
He submitted that it is not a case of kidnapping, abducting or inducing the victim, rather she herself eloped with the appellant and resided with him for 6 days.
It is argued that FSL report is negative.
It is submitted that the appellant is in jail since long and the appeal is likely to take a couple of years or even more in its final disposal.
Hence he prays that the appellant be enlarged on bail.
However, Mr. Avinash Singh, learned Panel Lawyer appearing for the State opposes the prayer for grant of bail.

sentences.text: We have heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the record of the court below.

Considering the submissions advanced by learned counsel for both the parties, also considering the evidence available on record, further considering the age of the prosecutrix who was aged 17 years and 7 months i.e. at the verge of attaining majority at the time of incident, and she remained with the appellant for 6 days, further considering the fact that the FSL report of the victim is negative, and the appellant is in jail since long and hearing of this appeal would take prolonged period of time, we deem it appropriate to allow the application for suspension of sentence and grant of bail moved on behalf of appellant.
Accordingly, the substantive jail sentence awarded to appellant Dharmendra Nishad by the learned trial Court is hereby suspended.
He shall be released on bail on his executing bail bond with surety to the satisfaction of the concerned trial Court for his appearance before the Registry of this Court on 10-1-2024.

He shall thereafter appear before the concerned trial Court on a date to be given by the Registry of this Court and shall continue to appear there on all such subsequent dates as are given to him by the said Court, interval being not less than 6 months, till final disposal of this appeal.
Consequently, IA No. 1/2023 preferred by appellant Dharmendra Nishad is allowed.

It is made clear that the observations made hereinabove are only confined for disposal of aforesaid IA filed in this appeal and it shall not be construed as an expression of opinion of this Court on the merits of the matter.
List this matter for final hearing in due course.

C.C. as per rules  Sd/- Sd/-
 (Naresh Kumar Chandravanshi) (Ramesh Sinha)
